data.rationale: jcv_ceil uses jcv_real_to_int to truncate v to an integer, then conditionally adds 1.0. The RTE assertion rte_28 (`\is_finite(\add_float(i, 1.0))`) requires that `i` (the return value of jcv_real_to_int) is finite. Without this postcondition from jcv_real_to_int, the proof is only held under an optimistic hypothesis.
